explore.title: Explore
explore.lead: Ask your data questions without building a dashboard first.
explore.forbidden.title: Explore is not available to your role
explore.forbidden.text: Explore runs free queries. Editors, admins and owners may use it, and so may anyone with query access to a data source; an admin can give you that. Dashboards shared with you still show their data.
explore.noDatasources.title: No data source to query
explore.noDatasources.text: Explore needs a data source. An admin adds them under Data sources.
explore.noDatasources.textAdmin: Explore needs a data source. Add one, then query it here.
explore.hint: Write a query and run it with Ctrl+Enter. The result appears here in a matching visualization.
explore.add.title: Add to dashboard
explore.history.title: History
explore.history.note: Only visible to you, kept for 30 days.
explore.history.empty: No history yet. Queries you run in Explore show up here.
explore.history.clearText: Your whole history in this organization is deleted. This cannot be undone.
explore.history.noteText: The text of your query is stored, including any values in it; results are not.
explore.guide.title: Start here: {kind}
explore.guide.nothingToPick: This source shows nothing to pick yet. Write a query above, or open the cheat sheet for examples.
explore.guide.schemaFailed: The source’s schema could not be read, so there is nothing to pick. Write a query above, or open the cheat sheet for examples.
explore.guide.cheatLead: Common patterns with names from this source. Insert puts one into the editor; nothing runs until you run it.
explore.guide.replaced: The query in the editor was replaced.
explore.guide.stepsQuery: Show the query of this step
explore.guide.takeOver: Use this query instead of the step
explore.schema.title: Schema
explore.schema.kind.label: label
explore.hint.label: Hint
explore.tip.runShortcut: {keys} runs the query straight from the editor.
explore.tip.steps: Steps on the right group, count and calculate on the result without writing a query. Under a group step, Show the query shows how it is written in SQL.
